title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Strengthening Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine

Fa Fa [2022] No. 34

In order to deeply implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, implement the major decisions and deployments of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on the revitalization and development of traditional Chinese medicine and the relevant requirements of the "Outline for Building a Strong Intellectual Property Country (2021-2035)", comprehensively strengthen the judicial protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, promote the inheritance of essence, upright innovation, and high-quality development of the cause and industry of traditional Chinese medicine, these opinions are formulated.

I. Adhere to the Correct Direction, Accurately Grasp the Overall Requirements for Strengthening Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine in the New Era

1. Guiding Ideology. Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, thoroughly implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, earnestly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on traditional Chinese medicine work, deeply understand the decisive significance of "establishing two safeguards", enhance the "four consciousnesses", strengthen the "four self-confidences", achieve the "two safeguards", adhere to the theme of promoting high-quality development, continuously improve the level of judicial protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine on the new journey of the new era, promote the inheritance and innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine, promote the excellent traditional Chinese culture, advance the construction of a Healthy China, and provide strong judicial services for comprehensively promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation through Chinese-style modernization.

2. Basic Principles. Adhere to the people-centered approach, give full play to the role of judicial functions, promote the improvement of traditional Chinese medicine service capabilities, better leverage the unique advantages of traditional Chinese medicine in disease prevention and treatment, and better protect people's health. Adhere to promoting inheritance and innovation, based on the development needs of traditional Chinese medicine in the new stage of development, improve and perfect the judicial protection system for intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, promote the effective connection between the protection of traditional knowledge in traditional Chinese medicine and the modern intellectual property system, and assist in the modernization and industrialization of traditional Chinese medicine. Adhere to strict protection in accordance with the law, correctly apply laws and regulations such as the Civil Code, the intellectual property specific laws, and the Traditional Chinese Medicine Law, effectively safeguard social fairness and justice and the legitimate rights and interests of right holders, implement punitive damages for intellectual property, and promote the creative transformation and innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine. Adhere to fair and reasonable protection, reasonably determine the boundaries and methods of protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, ensure that the scope and intensity of protection are commensurate with the degree of technical contribution of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the continuous enhancement of the capability for inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine.

II. Strengthen Trial Functions, Comprehensively Improve the Level of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine

3. Strengthen Patent Protection for Traditional Chinese Medicine. Follow the development laws of traditional Chinese medicine, accurately grasp the characteristics of innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, and improve the rules for judicial protection of patents in the field of traditional Chinese medicine. Correctly grasp the patent characteristics of different subject matters such as traditional Chinese medicine compositions, traditional Chinese medicine extracts, traditional Chinese medicine dosage forms, traditional Chinese medicine preparation methods, traditional Chinese medicine equipment, and medical uses, strengthen judicial review of administrative acts for patent authorization and confirmation in the field of traditional Chinese medicine in accordance with the law, promote the unification of administrative enforcement standards and judicial adjudication standards, and continuously meet the needs for patent protection of traditional Chinese medicine. Combine the traditional theories and industry characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine, reasonably determine the scope of protection of traditional Chinese medicine patent rights, and improve the standards for determining infringement. Strictly implement the early resolution mechanism for drug patent disputes, and promote the timely resolution of traditional Chinese medicine patent infringement disputes.

4. Strengthen Protection of Commercial Marks for Traditional Chinese Medicine. Strengthen judicial protection of well-known trademarks, traditional brands, and time-honored brands of traditional Chinese medicine, properly handle historical issues in accordance with the law, and promote the inheritance and development of traditional Chinese medicine brands. In accordance with the law, sanction malicious trademark registration acts in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, resolutely punish malicious litigation, curb abuse of rights, and strive to create a social environment of honesty and trustworthiness. Severely crack down on trademark infringement acts in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of right holders, and promote the construction of traditional Chinese medicine brands.

5. Strengthen Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine Medicinal Material Resources. Study and improve the rules for the application of law for the protection of geographical indications of traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials, curb acts of infringing geographical indications of traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials, guide the correct exercise of geographical indication rights, strengthen the protection of authentic traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials through the geographical indication protection mechanism, and promote the organic integration of geographical indications of traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials with the development of characteristic industries, ecological civilization construction, historical and cultural heritage, and comprehensive promotion of rural revitalization. In accordance with the law, strengthen the protection of new plant variety rights of traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials, and promote the establishment of a systematic, complete, scientific, and efficient system for the protection and utilization of germplasm resources of traditional Chinese medicine medicinal materials.

6. Maintain Fair Competition Order in the Traditional Chinese Medicine Market. Adhere to equal emphasis on regulation and development, strengthen judicial regulation of monopolistic acts in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, and maintain a unified, open, and orderly competitive traditional Chinese medicine market. In accordance with the law, sanction unfair competition acts such as false propaganda, commercial defamation, unauthorized use of well-known enterprise names in traditional Chinese medicine, and counterfeiting well-known traditional Chinese medicine drug names, packaging, and decorations, strengthen awareness of fair competition in the traditional Chinese medicine industry, promote the healthy and orderly development of the traditional Chinese medicine cause, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of consumers and social public interests.

7. Strengthen Protection of Trade Secrets and State Secrets in Traditional Chinese Medicine. In accordance with the law, protect trade secrets in traditional Chinese medicine, effectively curb acts of infringing trade secrets in traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine technology. Accurately grasp the relationship between information disclosure and trade secret protection, and in accordance with the law, protect traditional Chinese medicine information disclosed to administrative authorities due to reasons such as listing registration, supplementary applications, and drug re-registration. Properly handle the relationship between trade secret protection in traditional Chinese medicine and the reasonable flow of practitioners in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, while protecting trade secrets in accordance with the law, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of practitioners in the field of traditional Chinese medicine for proper employment and entrepreneurship. Implement special protection for the composition and production processes of traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions that are legally determined to be state secrets, and severely punish acts of stealing or leaking state secrets in traditional Chinese medicine.

8. Strengthen Protection of Copyright and Related Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. In accordance with the law, grasp the standards for determining works, strengthen protection of intellectual achievements formed through the collection, verification, sorting, and excavation of traditional Chinese medicine formulas, secret recipes, and diagnostic and treatment techniques, as well as the rights of creators. In accordance with the law, protect achievements formed from the sorting of ancient editions of traditional Chinese medicine classics, encourage the creation of traditional Chinese medicine culture and popular science works, and promote the inheritance and development of traditional Chinese medicine culture. Strengthen protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine genetic resources, traditional culture, traditional knowledge, and folk literature and arts, and promote the sorting and utilization of intangible cultural heritage. In accordance with the law, protect data resources formed from the sorting and research of traditional knowledge in traditional Chinese medicine, support the construction of databases for the protection of traditional knowledge in traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the development and utilization of traditional Chinese medicine data.

9. Strengthen Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine Varieties. In accordance with the law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of holders of certificates for protected traditional Chinese medicine varieties, promote the improvement of the protection system for traditional Chinese medicine varieties, encourage enterprises to research and develop traditional Chinese medicine varieties with clinical value, improve the quality of traditional Chinese medicine products, and promote the healthy and orderly development of the traditional Chinese medicine market.

10. Strengthen Protection of the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Traditional Chinese Medicine Innovation Entities. Accurately grasp the relationship between inheritance and innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, in accordance with the law, protect the research and development of new traditional Chinese medicine drugs based on ancient classic prescriptions, and encourage the conduct of technological innovation activities in traditional Chinese medicine. Accurately determine the role played by the material basis and clinical trial conditions provided by traditional Chinese medicine enterprises and the intellectual labor of traditional Chinese medicine research and development personnel in the formation of traditional Chinese medicine technological achievements, accurately define the legal boundary between service inventions and non-service inventions, in accordance with the law, support the right of persons who have made important contributions to the completion and transformation of traditional Chinese medicine technological achievements to obtain rewards and remuneration, and continuously stimulate the potential and vitality of innovation and development of traditional Chinese medicine.

11. Increase Punishment for Acts Infringing Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. In accordance with the law, take measures such as behavior preservation and sanctions against acts obstructing litigation, to promptly and effectively curb infringing acts in the field of traditional Chinese medicine. Actively apply rules such as evidence preservation, evidence production orders, shifting of the burden of proof, and the doctrine of obstruction of proof, to reduce the burden of proof on intellectual property right holders in traditional Chinese medicine. Correctly grasp the constituent elements of punitive damages, and for cases where the circumstances of infringement are serious, such as repeated infringement and infringement as a business, in accordance with the law, support the right holder's claim for punitive damages, effectively increase the amount of compensation for infringement. Increase the intensity of criminal crackdowns, in accordance with the law, punish criminal acts infringing intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, and give full play to the deterrent, preventive, and corrective functions of criminal penalties.

III. Deepen Reform and Innovation, Improve the Comprehensive Protection System for Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine

12. Improve the Mechanism for Ascertaining Technical Facts in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Select and appoint professional and technical personnel in the field of traditional Chinese medicine in a targeted manner, and enrich the national court technical investigation talent pool. Continuously improve the multi-technical fact ascertainment mechanism involving technical investigation officers, technical consulting experts, technical appraisal personnel, and expert assistants participating in litigation. Establish a mechanism for sharing technical investigation talents, accelerate the realization of "on-demand deployment" and "talent sharing" of traditional Chinese medicine technical talents nationwide. Select professional and technical personnel in the field of traditional Chinese medicine to participate in case trials, and promote the establishment of an expert jury system. Improve the procedures for technical personnel in the field of traditional Chinese medicine to appear in court, provide opinions on professional issues, and undergo questioning.

13. Strengthen Coordinated Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Do a good job in connecting different methods of intellectual property protection in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the continuous improvement of the judicial protection system for intellectual property. Deeply implement the "three-in-one" trial mechanism for civil, criminal, and administrative cases, and improve the overall effectiveness of judicial protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine. Improve the connection mechanism between administrative protection and judicial protection of intellectual property rights, strengthen coordination and cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the National Health Commission, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the National Copyright Administration, the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, the National Medical Products Administration, and the China National Intellectual Property Administration, realize the sharing and coordination of information resources, support local efforts to expand communication channels and methods, and promote the formation of work synergy. Support and expand diversified resolution mechanisms for intellectual property disputes in traditional Chinese medicine, rely on the people's court mediation platform to vigorously promote the connection between litigation and mediation, explore the system of judicial confirmation of administrative mediation agreements, and promote comprehensive management and source governance of disputes.

14. Enhance the Ability to Provide Judicial Services and Guarantees for Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Improve the talent cultivation and training mechanism, further enhance the professional level of judicial personnel in intellectual property trials for traditional Chinese medicine. Deeply grasp the new situations and new requirements, actively carry out investigation and research on issues concerning judicial protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, study and judge trial trends, summarize trial experience, and promptly respond to social concerns. Strengthen legal publicity on intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, establish and improve the case guidance system, actively publish typical cases of intellectual property protection in traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the dissemination of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge through the trial and publicity of typical cases, and create a good social atmosphere of common concern and support for the development of traditional Chinese medicine.

15. Strengthen Technological and Informatization Construction for Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Enhance the level of informatization in trials of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, use technologies such as big data and blockchain to build a coordination mechanism with intellectual property platforms such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights, and support the query and verification of information on the ownership, registration, and transfer of intellectual property. Vigorously promote the popularization and application of informatization technology, realize the online handling of all trial business processes, and improve the quality and efficiency of judicial protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine.

16. Strengthen International Exchange and Cooperation on Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Strengthen foreign-related trials of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign right holders in accordance with the law, and serve to guarantee the international development of traditional Chinese medicine. Adhere to coordinating the promotion of domestic rule of law and foreign-related rule of law, actively participate in the construction of international intellectual property rules in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, promote the integration of traditional Chinese medicine into the high-quality construction of the "Belt and Road", and assist traditional Chinese medicine in going global.

December 21, 2022
